mapper.select: select id, account_no, username, email, account_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_member_account where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select acc.id as memberId, acc.account_no as accountNo, acc.email as email, mp.nickname as nickname, p.id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, p.game_terminal as gameTerminal, p.game_account as gameAccount, p.certification_status as certificationStatus, p.player_status as playerStatus, acc.account_status as accountStatus, p.certified_time as certifiedTime, acc.create_time as createTime from basket_member_account acc left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = acc.id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.member_id = acc.id and p.is_delete = 0 where acc.is_delete = 0 and acc.email like concat('%', #{email}, '%') and mp.nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') and p.player_no like concat('%', #{playerNo}, '%')
and ( p.game_account like concat('%', #{gameId}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from basket_player_platform_account pa where pa.player_id = p.id and pa.is_delete = 0 and (pa.display_game_id like concat('%', #{gameId}, '%') or pa.normalized_game_id like concat('%', lower(trim(#{gameId})), '%')) ) )
and acc.account_status in #{s}
and p.certification_status = #{certificationStatus} and p.player_status = #{playerStatus} order by acc.create_time desc

select acc.id as memberId, acc.account_no as accountNo, acc.username as username, acc.email as email, acc.account_status as accountStatus, acc.create_time as accountCreateTime, acc.update_time as accountUpdateTime, mp.nickname as nickname, mp.gender as gender, mp.profile_status as profileStatus, p.id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, p.game_terminal as gameTerminal, p.game_account as gameAccount, p.game_nickname as gameNickname, p.position_code as positionCode, p.certification_status as certificationStatus, p.player_status as playerStatus, p.certified_time as certifiedTime, p.current_team_id as currentTeamId from basket_member_account acc left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = acc.id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.member_id = acc.id and p.is_delete = 0 where acc.id = #{memberId} and acc.is_delete = 0
